text:
maya: quick follow-up from the reservation ledger RFC — want to land the bookkeeping change before the next canary. TL;DR: proposal to switch from per-pool soft-reservoirs to a shared reservation ledger with per-tenant credit accounting. questions below.

leo: +1 on doing this in two phases (ledger read-only -> write path). we should avoid a big cutover.

raj: what do we gain vs current soft-reservoir? remind me of the failure modes.

maya: current soft-reservoir: each pool keeps local headroom credits that decay and are hard to reconcile cross-shard. leads to unfair bursts when tenants span shards and to double-counting after restarts. ledger = single source of truth for credits, easier global fairness and audits.

nina: will need new metrics. suggested: `ledger.total_credits`, `ledger.claim_rate_{tenant}`, `ledger.reconcile_errors`, and `ledger-stale-shards`. without these we won't be able to justify rollback.

beth: rollout plan idea: 1) deploy read-only ledger exporter + metrics, 2) enable read path (admit decisions consult ledger but pools still update local state), 3) switch write ownership to ledger (pools stop mutating local credits). each step monitored and rollbackable.

sam: question: performance / latency impact on admission path? extra RPC hop could hurt tail p50/p99.

leo: we can cache recent claims with a short TTL (100ms) and use optimistic admit + eventual reconciliation for tail-sensitive paths. admission pseudocode: 
```
if cache.has(tenant): use cache
else call ledger.get_and_reserve(tenant, amount)
```
If ledger fails, fallback to local reservoir for low-priority tenants.

maya: fallback policies: prefer local reservoir only for non-SLA tenants. SLA-tagged tenants should error rather than silently degrade. config snippet: 
```
admit_fallback:
  default: local_reservoir
  sla_tenants: fail_on_ledger_error
```

raj: accounting: need idempotency tokens on claims (request_id) and per-claim TTL to avoid leaked credits across restarts. if agent dies, claim should expire after `claim_ttl`. otherwise we'll see stuck reservations.

nina: add a reconcile job that scans for stuck claims and publishes `ledger.reclaimed_credits` metric. also track `claim_expiry_rate`.

beth: ops runbook notes? what page do we add for playbook on partial ledger outage?

maya: add to runbook `dedicated-pool-ledger` with steps: 1) flip read-only -> check metrics, 2) flip read-path -> watch `claim_rate` and `reconcile_errors`, 3) flip write ownership. include rollback knobs: `admit.use_ledger=false` and `admit.fallback=force-local`.

sam: do we need a migration for existing local credits? how to avoid double-crediting during cutover?

leo: during phase 2 we should atomically checkpoint per-pool local credits into ledger via `checkpoint(pool_id, snapshot)` which returns a mapping and marks pool migrated. admission checks will consult both: ledger wins if pool marked migrated. this avoids double-counting.

raj: agree. also ensure checkpoint uses epoch token so we don't apply stale snapshots.

nina: telemetry note: tag checkpoint events with `checkpoint_duration_ms` and `checkpoint_conflicts`. we'll want alert thresholds.

beth: who will own the operator changes? i can take the control-plane helm/CR updates for stage gating.

maya: thanks. ownership: leo + maya for runtime changes, beth for operator helm, raj for accounting idempotency, nina for metrics, sam will do perf sign-off.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: bump `ledger-exporter` to v0.9.0 in staging at 2024-10-12T18:00Z by beth.

sam: quick performance thought — measure extra hop p50 and p99 for small admits with a synthetic workload. if cache TTL helps p50 but not p99 we'll need an admission fastpath that avoids IO for the first 20ms.

leo: idea: fastpath uses local optimistic token that is charged back during reconciliation. set optimistic_limit = min(local_reservoir, 0.05 * tenant_commit). small allowance avoids large overcommit but keeps latency.

maya: decision summary: move to shared ledger, rollout in 3 phased steps (metrics -> read -> write), checkpoint local credits in phase2 to avoid double-counting, implement idempotent claims + TTL, add metrics and reconcile job, fallback rules per-SLA. action items assigned.

raj: one more: ensure ledger API has `bulk_checkpoint` to reduce N RPCs during cluster start.

beth: ack, will add to helm and CI checks for bulk endpoints.

nina: I'll add dashboards and alerts PR for the key metrics.

maya: thanks team. I'll write a short follow-up RFC note with these decisions and link to the rollout checklist. :thumbsup:
